message.content:
Based on my search, here is the information about PreLicenseTraining login:

## Main Student Login Portal

The primary login page for students is:
- **https://prelicensetraining.com/login**

To log in, you will need to enter your **login name** and **password**. (Tip: Your login name may be your email address unless you specified otherwise during registration.)

## Other Login Portals

Depending on your account type, there are also these login options:

| Account Type | Login URL |
|-------------|-----------|
| **Students (PSI Online)** | https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login |
| **Mentors/Recruiters/Companies** | https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login |
| **Infinity Schools Mentors** | https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login |

## Forgot Your Password?

If you've forgotten your password, you can use the password recovery option available at the PSI Online portal:
- **https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword**

## New User?

If you don't have an account yet, you can register at:
- **https://prelicensetraining.com/register**

---

**About PreLicenseTraining.com:** The platform provides online insurance pre-licensing and continuing education training, featuring streaming video instruction, online textbooks, practice exams, and a virtual testing center called StudyHall. They have helped over 150,000 individuals obtain their insurance licenses.

---
